ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the trailing edges, tips, and central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity region across the main body of both lobes; continuous low-intensity perimeter along the trailing edge; irregular low-intensity cluster localized at the median notch base; scattered low-intensity punctate spots on the left and right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 62 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.15 relative to the lobe vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe distal section exhibits higher pixel-amplitude variance (jaggedness) than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature on the outer leading edges tapering to acute points at both distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several discrete, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (approx. 4-8 pixels diameter) visible against the high-intensity background on both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip shows a notably jagged and irregular low-intensity geometric profile compared to the more uniform taper of the left tip.
